name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Expense Claims API for all claim submission, approval, and payroll export operations.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client used for employee, manager, and finance sign-in via the browser.

description: Single-page React app serving three role-scoped views: employees submit and track claims, managers review and act on a pending queue, and finance reviews approved claims and triggers payroll exports. Holds no data of its own — all state lives in expense-api.
